kind: Consolidated no-crop visual overview of the final simulator package

visualReview.notes: Explicit original-resolution sheet inspection: all seven profile rows contain dark Home/target/tutorial followed by their light counterparts, 42 complete labeled frames with no cropping. Cream/cocoa, Fredoka, coral/pistachio, actor identity and square tactile board remain coherent across compact, regular, iPad, enlarged text and Reduce Motion. Enlarged content naturally continues below the viewport; separate reviewed bottom endpoints in the complete package establish reachability. No additional material defect found; this overview supplements the per-original review.
